node.statement: Let M=max{1,K_sq,C_prod} and choose e_diag>0 no larger than e_sq, e_adj, e_prod, and 1/(64M); set d=K_sq e and q=C_prod e. Then the polynomial p(t)=t^2-(1-d)t+q has two real roots r_-<r_+, with r_-=2q/((1-d)+sqrt((1-d)^2-4q)) <=4q<1/8 and r_+=(1-d)-r_- >=1-(K_sq+4C_prod)e. Also r_+/2>1/8.
